item.title: Samar Hazarika, Dhanada Pathak Named for Silpi Awards 2026
item.description: GUWAHATI: Renowned singer Late Samar Hazarika has been honoured posthumously, while Dhanada Pathak has been named the recipient of the prestigious Silpi Awards for 2026, announced by Assam’s Cultural Affairs Department on Friday, January 16. The awards recognise outstanding contributions to the state’s cultural landscape and are presented annually ahead of Silpi Diwas, observed on January 17. item.title: Right to Disconnect Bill Sparks Debate Over Work-Life Balance in Guwahati
item.description: In Guwahati, the idea of switching off after work hours feels more like a privilege than a right. Phones keep buzzing with messages from office groups, emails appear late in the night, and many workers say the day does not truly end when they leave their desks. The booming digital work culture, once seen as efficient, has now blurred the line between job and home so much that both seem to overlap without pause. item.description: From tomatoes to chillies, Guwahati’s vegetable markets have steadily eaten into household budgets since the pandemic Over the past five years, a staple of every Indian kitchen, vegetables has become a gauge of economic pressure in Assam’s largest city.
